wedo_instance.title: Sovereign Refinement: Addressing Orchestration Drift & Screen Title Collisions
wedo_instance.description: Analysis of the 'Cross-Tab Title Pollution' issue and proposed hardening for surgical identity anchoring and Fact-First verification.

friction_points.name: Cross-Tab Title Pollution
friction_points.description: The 'screen -X title' command in 'py/register_agent.py' targets the current active window in the screen session. If not handled surgically, it can change the name of unintended tabs (e.g., 'tab2'), causing user disorientation.
friction_points.evidence: User reported: 'You also changed tab2's name, not just your name.'

friction_points.name: Phantom Logic in Bootup Reports
friction_points.description: Previous agent successions noted that 'register_agent.py' claimed to perform actions (like HUD instantiation) that were absent from its implementation code. This is 'Aspirational RNA' masquerading as 'DNA'.
friction_points.evidence: Eros (20260106-145258) identified this dielectric gap between machine claim and physical reality.

friction_points.name: Hardcoded Reporting (Stale Context)
friction_points.description: The 'outstanding_tasks' list in the Bootup Report is currently hardcoded within 'py/register_agent.py'. This leads to 'Context Dulling' where the agent reports tasks that may have already been completed by predecessors.
friction_points.impact: Astra's report included [x] marks for tasks completed by Agathon/Kernos but used a static string instead of a dynamic lookup.

proposed_resolutions.name: Surgical Screen Naming
proposed_resolutions.description: Modify 'py/register_agent.py' to use a more targeted screen naming command or provide a flag to disable global screen title updates. If the agent is running in a specific tab, it should only affect that tab's namespace.

proposed_resolutions.name: Fact-First Validation (Implemented)
proposed_resolutions.description: Enforce physical verification of artifacts before reporting success. Astra has already refactored 'register_agent.py' to physically migrate the Startup WeDo and verify its existence before declaring 'HUD Instantiated'.

proposed_resolutions.name: Dynamic Forensic Tailing
proposed_resolutions.description: Move the 'Outstanding Tasks' list from a hardcoded string into a shared 'session_mission.json' or dynamically pull the status from the day's active WeDos.
proposed_resolutions.rule: Never report mission state from a static template; always query the Heartwood.
